text:
andrew: Heads-up — noticed a weird mismatch on the latency page. p95 for /v1/generate spiked to ~420ms in the 1h rollup, but the endpoint-level breakdown adds up to ~220ms. dashboard looks wrong, or am I missing something?

maya: hmm that sounds like an aggregation/rollup bug. which rollup window? 1h or 6h?

andrew: 1h. p50/p95/p99 are all inconsistent vs the per-endpoint cards. p50 is fine, but the p95 diverges.

sam: could be sampling: we changed route-based sampling for quota routes last week. if the rollup uses sampled histograms differently it can shift percentiles.

elaine: also check if fallback routing is being tagged correctly. we've seen double-counting when middleware wraps request twice (main route + fallback).

telemetry-bot: Alert: metric-consistency-check failed for metric=latency.p95, endpoint=/v1/generate, window=3600s, deviation=95th: 420ms vs breakdown:220ms. rule_id=consistency-03

andrew: good point, sam/elaine — how can I quickly validate raw histograms? I can hit the metrics API but not sure which query to run.

maya: try the /internal/telemetry/raw endpoint. i usually do: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://telemetry.internal/api/raw?metric=latency.histogram&endpoint=/v1/generate&window=3600" | jq .
```
It returns bucket counts+sample_rate. multiply counts by 1/sample_rate before merging.

sam: if sample_rate different across routes the t-digest merge will be off. our rollup assumes equal sampling unless sample_rate is attached to each histogram.

elaine: digging through logs — here is an example line from request tracer showing wrapped middleware: 
```
[2026-03-17T12:34:21Z] req_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate -> fallback=/v1/generate-legacy latency_ms=410 tags=[routing:primary, fallback:true]
```
If both primary and fallback emit latency samples for same request and they end up in different buckets, rollup may merge them incorrectly.

andrew: ohhh. that would inflate p95. how many requests have fallback:true? can we filter them out in the rollup?

maya: we can change rollup pipeline to drop fallback-tagged samples for endpoint-level aggregates, or prefer the sample with "final=true" tag. But that is a schema change; needs careful rollout.

sam: another option: during rollup do a dedupe by req_id within the window, but that needs storing a small bloom filter per rollup shard — more expensive.

elaine: for a quick mitigation: update dashboard to compute percentiles from raw histograms with sample_rate applied and exclude tag fallback:true. low-risk quick fix.

andrew: agree — can you open a PR to make the dashboard query include `tag!=fallback:true`? that should bring p95 back in line while we implement a long-term fix.

maya: i'll draft the PR. also adding a note in the rollout UX: when we do canary/fallback experiments the console should surface "fallback traffic excluded" or similar so users understand metric differences.

sam: filed issue #4129: "rollup dedupe for routed/fallback requests" with design notes. assigning to eng-platform.

andrew: quick check — is quota routing injecting synthetic latency logs (we add 5ms for queued tokens)? that could nudge p95.

elaine: quota routing does add a small enqueue_time sample but it's tagged `enqueue_ms` not `service_latency_ms`. unlikely to be counted. still worth verifying.

telemetry-bot: Note: created incident stub incident-2026-03-17-telemetry-4129 for metric skew.

maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/824 — dashboard query updated to exclude `fallback:true` and apply sample_rate correction. staging patch deployed to console-staging.

andrew: deployed to staging looks good — p95 now matches breakdown within 3%. can we hotfix prod?

sam: i'm doing a quick smoke to ensure no N+1 on large endpoints. if all green i'll merge and promote.

elaine: follow-up: we should add a guard in the ingestion pipeline that rejects duplicate recordings when req_id present and final=true present. low-level fix ticket added.

andrew: thanks all. action items: maya PR to production, sam smoke + promote, elaine follow-up ingestion ticket, and we'll update rollout UX docs for fallback visibility. :thumbsup:

maya: will do, tagging eng-sre and product for awareness.

sam: merged and promoted at 1849234670, hotfix live. p95 aligned. will keep monitoring. :rocket:

andrew: closing the thread once telemetry confirms no more drift. great work.
